snippet.title: Pax Autocratica - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Pax Autocratica is a satirical totalitarian colony sim with roguelite FPS combat. Build your base, enact policies and rule with compassion or tyranny, the choice is yours. Lead your battalion against the factions of an authoritarian empire and unite the Tyris System under your banner.

Play the demo now on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/1067360/Pax_Autocratica/?utm_medium=youtube

All hail the State.
